title: Milestone 4: writable Prospectus sales and customer-success proof
description: Deliver a separate Prospectus application consuming actual shared Kanbus UI, generic issue operations and Virtuus storage. Configure prospect records, sales-funnel stages, salesperson ownership/follow-up and customer-success follow-up. Use ordinary type/status/assignee/custom-field queries, not specialized CRM tables or APIs. Demonstrate create, stage transition and reload against a real writable backend. Keep development tracking separate from CRM records. Public contact/demo intake is narrow and reveals no CRM records. Done when local and deployed proofs are explicit and all milestone stories pass.
